bias.en: Mixed · MACD crossed down, averages holding
bias.zh: 多空交织 · MACD 下穿，均线支撑仍在

read.en: Tesla slipped 0.6% on Oct 23 to $372.22, trading between $365.27 and $377.30. It is above the falling 10-day ($371.3), rising 30-day ($369.5) and falling 100-day ($368.2) averages, and below the rising 5-day ($375.0) and falling 200-day ($386.4). MACD crossed back below its signal on Oct 23 but is above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($351.67), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月23日下跌 0.6%，收于 $372.22，盘中区间 $365.27–377.30。股价位于下行的 10 日（$371.3）、上行的 30 日（$369.5）和下行的 100 日均线（$368.2）上方，低于上行的 5 日（$375.0）和下行的 200 日均线（$386.4）。MACD 于 10月23日重新下穿信号线，但仍在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$351.67），RSI 为 52。

read.en: The close held the $368.2–371.3 averages (10, 30 and 100-day) after a dip to $365.3. Resistance is $375–377.6 (5-day, Oct 20 high), then $386.4–388.9 (200-day, $388 cap) and $409 (Apr 17 high). Support is $368.2–371.3, then $363.6–365.3 (Oct 20 and 23 lows) and $349.3–351.7 (Oct 16 low, SAR). A close above $388.9 would target $409–418; a close below $363.6 would open $350.
